title: Ongoing CRM Support
meta: A starter sprint of CRM fixes, changes and new reports, handled through one request list. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: CRM support, starting with a fixed sprint
overview: Send us a list of the small things that annoy your team in the CRM and we work through it in one fixed sprint. That might be a broken field, a new report, a rule that misfires or a user who needs a different view. We confirm the list and order in writing, do the work in your account and send a summary of what changed. Monthly care after the sprint is quoted separately, once we know your needs.

faq: No. Each order is a fixed sprint with a clear list and a finish date. If you want regular monthly care after that, we quote it separately based on what we saw during the sprint.
One small change with a clear result, such as fixing a field, building a view, adjusting a rule or adding a user. A request that needs a new pipeline or a big import is scoped separately.
After you order, you share the list in the order form or by message, with screenshots if possible. We reply with the confirmed list and an order of work, so you know what to expect.
Can you fix problems from another consultant?
Yes, as long as we have admin access to your CRM. We review what exists before changing it, tell you if something looks risky and keep a note of every change we make so it can be undone.
